text:
Sam Chen: FYI — Peregrine Labs is hitting 429s from our SG edge during their pilot. They're ramping traffic for a new feature rollout tomorrow and asked for a short-term QPS uplift + CIDR allowlist for their peering range (203.0.113.0/24). Can we triage? :eyes:
Diego Rivera: how big of a bump are they asking for?
Sam Chen: requested 2x current QPS for 72 hours and the CIDR so their infra team can route directly. Also asked to pin region to ap-southeast-1 for latency.
Maya Patel: customer is on a renewal conversation — CS flagged this as high-impact. If we can make this seamless it reduces churn risk. Recommend temporary autop-revoke at 72h and a small note for renewals team.
Nisha Rao: technically we can add a per-customer allowlist entry and increase QPS for a limited window. Need: 1) customer contact (email + ticket) 2) justification in case of audit 3) intended expiry. Also we'll need to add a route policy to tie traffic to ap-southeast-1.
Sam Chen: copying customer contact: infra@peregrine.example.com — they confirmed the CIDR and provided peering proof. I'll paste their signed note into the ticket. Set expiry 72h from now.
Diego Rivera: ops checklist: 1) add CIDR 203.0.113.0/24 to per-customer allowlist 2) set QPS override to 2x for customer key 3) pin region ap-southeast-1 routing 4) set TTL 72h with auto-revoke 5) notify CS + customer when done.
Nisha Rao: ok. I need the API key prefix and the ticket number. Also, confirm that we keep cache and batching unchanged (we don't want to accidentally change latency profile).
Sam Chen: ticket #CS-4729, key prefix: per-labs-01. They confirmed no KV changes.
ops-bot: [automation] request received: modify-allowlist for customer per-labs-01. ETA 15m.
Diego Rivera: applying change now. Will run through the staging validation then promote.
Diego Rivera: change applied — CIDR added, QPS override set to 2x, pinned to ap-southeast-1. TTL set to 72h (auto-revoke timestamp: 4056895923). Notified customer and renewal lead. :white_check_mark:
Maya Patel: amazing — can you add a short note in the renewal tracker: "Peregrine Labs: onboarding ramp, temporary QPS bump 2x applied, auto-revoke in 72h. Reduced near-term churn risk; follow-up scheduled post-ramp."
Sam Chen: done — added note and scheduled a 48h check-in with Peregrine. Customer feedback: "This made our rollout smooth, thanks — please keep us posted if you need logs."
Nisha Rao: will monitor edge metrics for anomalies and report if any 5xx trends appear.
Diego Rivera: closing thread — ops will revert automatically but will also revert early if traffic normalizes.
Sam Chen: thanks team :pray:
